description: Match up to 1,000 rows of your own company list to official Korean identifiers. Each row is a string or an object/array of cells — a company name and/or a business registration number (10 digits), corporate registration number (13), DART code (8) or stock code (6), in any order. Returns per row: result (matched / ambiguous / not_found / not_supported / invalid), match_type, entity_id, official numbers and the official English name; several equally good candidates are answered as ambiguous, not guessed. Identifiers only (tax status is free at verify_company). Rows are not stored. Each row uses one unit of your daily limit. Requires a Jaryo API key (free: https://jaryo.org/keys/). (회사 목록 맞추기)
name: match_companies
title: Match a list of Korean companies
